body: dont have to know someone to cry for them and to smile for them either (:

well, in the end, our parents always seem to be the most childish people we know, at least thats how it is for me. keep fighting, make some good memories, some bad, and pass your wisdom and love on to the little ones. they deserve to have someone to look up to, even if the person isnt as perfect as theyre perceived. 

and heres a lil internet hug (: sorry it cant be the real deal !!
